svg.title: Retune timing with input-side switching
svg.desc: The NCOs switch at input sample s_k, the start of packet k on the input side. After one pipeline delay, packet k reaches the packetizer, preceded by a context packet carrying its timestamp. A filter transient straddles the boundary between packets k minus 1 and k.
svg.text: Change indicator set, same timestamp as packet k (SID time of s_k)
